name: pi-desktop
description: Pi-desktop local coding agent desktop application

scripts.demo: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js demo
scripts.test:desktop: npm run build && node --test test/desktop.test.mjs test/pi-desktop.test.mjs test/execution-ui.test.mjs test/resource-market.test.mjs test/pi-input.test.mjs test/workflows.test.mjs test/model-catalog.test.mjs
scripts.package:win: npm run build && powershell.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/create-app-icon.ps1 && node scripts/prepare-desktop-package.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.cjs --win --x64 --dir --publish never && npm run package:verify && electron-builder --config electron-builder.cjs --win --x64 --prepackaged release/win-unpacked --publish never
